meta.title: Meet Groscove Ultra
meta.description: The platform where brands, heroes and agencies close deals fast: opportunities, schedule, terms and deliverables in one place, plus the app where people follow the heroes.

hero.title: The platform where brands, heroes and agencies close deals fast.
hero.lead: Opportunities, schedule, terms and deliverables in one place. Plus the app where people follow the heroes through content, programs and recipes.

what.title: What Ultra is
what.lead: Four kinds of access, one shared flow. Each profile sees only what it needs.

brand.title: Brand
brand.body: Finds heroes, sends campaigns and follows every deliverable through to the report.

hero.title: Hero
hero.body: Gets clear opportunities, organizes the schedule and publishes for their audience.

agency.title: Agency
agency.body: Runs everything in the middle: casting, deals, deadlines and the central schedule.

app.title: App
app.body: Where people follow the heroes: content, programs, recipes and Today.

how.title: How it works
how.lead: From picking a hero to approved content, with the agency in the middle of every conversation.

choose.title: The brand chooses
choose.body: Browses the hero catalog, compares side by side and builds a shortlist.

request.title: Sends the campaign
request.body: Describes the action, the period and the budget. The agency gets the request.

consult.title: The hero answers
consult.body: The agency brings the opportunity to the hero, who accepts or declines.

terms.title: Terms accepted
terms.body: The deal terms are recorded, with version and acceptance.

deliver.title: Creation and approval
deliver.body: The hero sends the deliverables. Change requests and approvals are kept by version.

report.title: Results
report.body: The brand follows each deliverable by stage and opens the campaign report.

how.note: The brand doesn't talk to the hero directly: the agency sits in the middle and answers for both sides.

heroes.title: For heroes
heroes.lead: Brand work and your audience in a single portal: the Hero Portal.

page.title: Public page
page.body: Your page in the app, with cover, intro and your content.

content.title: Content and recipes
content.body: Publish posts, content and recipes for the people who follow you.

portal.title: Hero Portal
portal.body: A home with what needs you today, tasks and notices.

opportunities.title: Opportunities
opportunities.body: Brand proposals, brought by the agency, to accept or decline.

agenda.title: Schedule
agenda.body: Actions, deadlines and availability, with a link to your phone's calendar.

finance.title: Finances
finance.body: Agreed amounts and what's receivable, per deal, for tracking. Ultra does not process payments.

brands.title: For brands
brands.lead: Pick heroes, send campaigns and follow results without a side spreadsheet.

catalog.title: Hero catalog
catalog.body: Search by segment, compare side by side and keep your shortlist.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.body: Every deliverable by stage, from request to approval, on one screen.

calls.title: Calls
calls.body: Post a need, receive proposals from agencies and compare before hiring.

sponsorship.title: Sponsorship
sponsorship.body: See hero events open to sponsorship and say whether you're interested.

budget.title: Budget and payments
budget.body: Budget per campaign, installments and due dates, for tracking. Ultra does not charge or process payments.

reports.title: Reports
reports.body: The campaign report and the library of approved content.

agency.title: For agencies
agency.lead: The whole operation in one place: who's available, what's stuck and what's due today.

casting.title: Casting
casting.body: Hero profiles with media kit, networks, documents, availability and history.

deals.title: Deals
deals.body: From request to close: terms, conversation, tasks and deliverables for each deal.

castBuilder.title: Cast builder
castBuilder.body: Build the cast for a proposal from your roster, hero by hero.

agenda.title: Central schedule and Real-Time Culture
agenda.body: Every hero's actions in one calendar, and what's happening right now.

app.title: For app users
app.lead: The audience side: follow the heroes and bring what they do into your own routine.

content.title: Content
content.body: Videos, posts and articles from the heroes, organized by topic.

programs.title: Programs
programs.body: Sequences to follow at your own pace, from start to finish.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.body: Recipes from the heroes, with a shopping list and Cook mode.

today.title: Today
today.body: Your day in focus, measured by the watch you connect, once the connection is available.

calendar.title: Groscove Calendar
calendar.lead: The year's cultural calendar, to plan actions at the right moment.

points.territories: Dates by territory: football, sports, music, entertainment, fashion, retail, holidays and more.
points.interest: Brands, agencies and heroes mark interest and link proposals to events.
points.where: Available in the brand, agency and hero portals.

cost.a: Using the app is free. There's no plan or subscription.

payments.q: Does Ultra charge or make payments?
payments.a: No. Ultra records deal amounts and orders for tracking, without charging or moving money.

access.q: How do brands, agencies and heroes get in?
access.a: Create your account by choosing your profile: Hero, Brand, Agency or just use the app. Got an invitation? Sign in with the invited email.

devices.q: Does it work on my phone?
devices.a: Yes. It works in your phone's and computer's browser, and you can add it to your home screen.

data.a: What is stored, for how long and how to delete your account is in the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

final.title: Ready to start?
final.lead: Create your account with name, email and phone, or explore the app first.
